blocks.text: We are writing to express our concern regarding the delayed delivery of order PO-4471, which was expected on 20th November 2026. The order comprises 600 bearings.

We kindly request that you provide us with a new delivery date in writing within the next 5 working days. Should we not receive this information, we reserve the right to apply the penalty as outlined in clause 9 of our agreement.

Paolo Ferri
Purchasing Manager
Acme Components
